% A document with titletoc's partial table of contents and tocloft's
% \newlistof in an \include'd file, beside the .aux of an earlier build,
% which names no list and reads the .aux of the \include with \@input.
% That .aux names the tocloft list in an \@writefile line. Beside are
% the .ptc and the tocloft list of that build, each with a line of text
% and an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document does not
% define. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newcommand{\listexamplename}{Examples}
\newlistof{example}{lop}{\listexamplename}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{lop}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\include{test-staleaux-ptc-include/chapter}
\end{document}
